content:
Evidence is the **APPLICATION CODE LIST** (three CMIS application codes) plus the technical table (reach, aggregated 400GbE / 425 Gbps line rate). One ordering part number; three selectable host/media configurations—not separate SKUs.

```json
{
  "modes": [
    {
      "label": "CMIS App 1 — 400GBASE-SR8",
      "host_interface_name": "400GAUI-8",
      "media_interface_name": "400GBASE-SR8",
      "frame": "1x 400GAUI-8 (8x 50G)",
      "standards_code": "400GBASE-SR8",
      "bit_rate_gbps": 400.0,
      "reach_km": 0.1,
      "fec_type": "RS_GENERIC"
    },
    {
      "label": "CMIS App 2 — 8×50GBASE-SR breakout",
      "host_interface_name": "50GAUI-1",
      "media_interface_name": "50GBASE-SR",
      "frame": "8x 50GAUI-1 (1x 50G)",
      "standards_code": "50GBASE-SR",
      "bit_rate_gbps": 400.0,
      "reach_km": 0.1,
      "fec_type": "RS_GENERIC"
    },
    {
      "label": "CMIS App 3 — 4×100GBASE-SR2",
      "host_interface_name": "100GAUI-2",
      "media_interface_name": "100GBASE-SR2",
      "frame": "4x 100GAUI-2 (4x 100G)",
      "standards_code": "100GBASE-SR2",
      "bit_rate_gbps": 400.0,
      "reach_km": 0.1,
      "fec_type": "PFEC"
    }
  ]
}
```
